candidate.selection_reason: user-controlled variable name -> embedded in assignment code -> potential scope pollution if not properly escaped
candidate.source_summary: node.object.name comes from SymbolNode constructor which accepts a string parameter. This name is parsed from user input expressions like 'a=2' where 'a' becomes the symbol name.
candidate.sink_summary: setSafeProperty(scope, jsName, value) assigns a value to a property on the scope object using the symbol name as the property key.
candidate.guard_summary: setSafeProperty validates that the target object is a plain object and prevents overriding inherited properties like constructor/toString. The stringify function escapes double quotes in the property name. SymbolNode validates that the name is a string.
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled symbol names from parsed expressions are used as property keys in scope assignments. While stringify escapes quotes and setSafeProperty has some validation, the property name itself is not validated against a whitelist of safe property names.
used_variable_sources: node.object.name (from SymbolNode constructor, derived from parsed user input)
called_function_context: setSafeProperty (validates plain object and prevents overriding inherited properties)
enclosing_conditions: if (!node.index) - only for direct variable assignments like 'a=2'
candidate.context_summary: The code compiles assignment expressions to JavaScript. For direct variable assignments (no index), it uses setSafeProperty to assign values to the scope object using the symbol name as the property key.
unresolved_facts: Whether there are additional validation layers in the expression parsing that restrict symbol names
Whether the scope object has any additional security controls beyond setSafeProperty validation
Whether there are any known dangerous property names that could be exploited despite the existing controls

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
target_cwe.description: The product constructs all or part of a code segment using externally-influenced input from an upstream component, but it does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes special elements that could modify the syntax or behavior of the intended code segment. Common in: input_validation.
remediation_steps: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Implement strict input validation with whitelisting

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
stage3_hypothesis.fit_reason: Property injection through user-controlled keys could lead to code injection if the scope object is used in code generation contexts
